from object_detector_tool import tool

def count_bat_in_image(image_path):
    # Load the image
    image = Image.open(image_path)

    # Use the ground detection tool to detect baseball bat objects
    detection = tool.execute(image=image, labels=["baseball bat"], threshold=0.35, model_size="base", padding=20)

    if len(detection) > 0:
        # Get the bounding box of the baseball bat object
        obj = detection[0]
        bbox = obj["box"]
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = bbox

        # Calculate the height and width of the baseball bat, excluding the padding
        height = y2 - y1
        width = x2 - x1

        # Calculate the area of the baseball bat
        area = height * width

        return area
    else:
        return False
</command>
